important_note: All conformal artifacts were fitted and calibrated on clean fit and calibration splits only. The same q_hat was reused for clean and distorted test images; no corrupted test data was used for recalibration. Paired percentile intervals resample source recordings, preserving the two-row recording clusters. These intervals are conditional on the fixed noise seed. Results are robustness measurements on the held-out proxy dataset, not evidence of real-world forensic validity.
